purpose: Teach: ウニ/髭/洋書/つば/にんにく/マヨネーズ/ヤギ/泡盛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、北海道でウニを召し上がったって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer you mentioned — the one from Hokkaido who had uni — apparently he really enjoyed it.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Soft opening. Bringing up a remembered detail about someone Aoi noticed. Gentle curiosity underneath, like she's inviting Aoi to smile at the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、立派な髭を蓄えていらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that same customer had such a distinguished beard. Did you notice?
lines.style: Quiet, almost conspiratorial. Noticing-the-small-things tone. A slight smile in the voice, like she's testing whether Aoi saw what she saw. Conversational, not leading.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、本屋で洋書を買ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And at the bookstore — you saw him buying foreign books, didn't you?
lines.style: Continuing the thread. Slightly more animated than before, building a picture. Open curiosity, like she's enjoying piecing together who this person is through Aoi's eyes.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お茶のつばが飛んじゃってごめんって謝られてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: He even apologized when he accidentally sprayed his tea. So considerate of him.
lines.style: Softer shift. Gentle amusement underneath. A touch of wry affection in the observation — finding sweetness in the small, awkward moment. Trailing tone that says 'don't you think?'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、にんにくたっぷりのオイル料理にしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should add something new to the menu — maybe a really garlicky oil-based dish. What do you think?
lines.style: Brightening energy. Forward-looking, collaborative. Opening cleanly on the idea. Inviting Aoi's input without waiting for permission. Light, constructive tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、自家製マヨネーズを使いましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Or we could feature homemade mayonnaise — make it from scratch ourselves.
lines.style: Building on the previous thought. Practical, grounded energy. Clear conviction underneath. Slight emphasis on 'homemade' — pride in doing it properly. Warm but purposeful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、絵本のヤギさん見て大喜びしてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and that little one who came in? She was absolutely delighted by the goat in the picture book.
lines.style: Warmth softens noticeably. Genuine pleasure in the memory. Slow, tender pace. The voice of someone who loves seeing children happy. A small, satisfied smile in every word.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、沖縄出身で泡盛がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer from Okinawa we mentioned — he's quite fond of awamori, naturally.
lines.style: Closing observation. Reflective, drawing a thread back. Knowing tone — the kind of detail that makes someone feel seen. Gentle fadeout, as if filing away another small knowing thing about the people around them.
